contracts.source: Infineon press release: Infineon and Eaton leverage silicon carbide technology to (09-29-2026)
contracts.signal: Infineon will deliver silicon carbide (SiC) power devices to Eaton for use in Eaton's medium-voltage solid-state transformer (MVSST) 2.0 platform, designed for deployment across APAC and targeting 800 VDC AI data center power distribution architectures; Eaton says MVSST 2.0 is one of the first medium-voltage SST platforms to achieve IEC certification. The two companies are exploring next-generation SST platforms based on 2.3 kV and 3.3 kV SiC power modules.
contracts.type: supply agreement (SiC power devices for solid-state transformers)
